cs_enter: Bigby stands at the door, Nerissa waits inside.
cs_enter (Bigby okay?): Bigby walks inside, Nerissa steps out of his way.  There is something awkward between them because of the events of 102 and 103.
cs_enter (1st Dialog Idle): Nerissa takes her seat as Bigby rounds his desk.  When the player chooses their answer...
cs_enter (1st Dialog Choice): ... Bigby takes his seat and checks out the shitty coffee on his desk.  A good chunk of the scene will play out from this blocking.
cs_bigbyComforts (Knock Knock): Off the knock at the door, Nerissa jumps to her feet.
cs_bigbyHelps: As Nerissa struggles with how to say what she came there to say, Bigby takes the seat next to her.  This would be BEFORE Bigby tries to grab for the ribbon.
cs_bigbyComforts: Nerissa takes Bigby's hand.
cs_snowArrives: Bigby moves toward the door.  Nerissa asks if they can keep this conversation between the two of them, even if it is just Snow at the door.
cs_convoAtDoor: Nerissa takes her seat again before Bigby opens the door for Snow.
cs_convoAtDoor (Nerissa Departs): Nerissa pushes past Bigby and Snow.
cs_snowBusiness: Bigby walks back to his desk (for cigs?).  Snow follows a bit into the office.
cs_snowBusiness (Guilty Sigh): Snow and Bigby step into the hall.  Bigby shuts the door.
cs_expectations: Snow and Bigby begin their walk towards the elevator.
cs_expectations (Ticking Clock): Bigby and Snow reach the elevator.  Bigby hits the button and they wait for it to arrive.
cs_expectations (Okay. I will): Bigby gets in the elevator and heads up to Beauty and Beast's place.
